SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM lineitem l
JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR')
  AND l.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'
  AND (
    (p.p_brand = 'Brand#12' 
     AND p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG')
     AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 11
     AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
    OR
    (p.p_brand = 'Brand#23' 
     AND p.p_container IN ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK')
     AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 10 AND 20
     AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10)
    OR
    (p.p_brand = 'Brand#34' 
     AND p.p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')
     AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 20 AND 30
     AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15)
  )

    AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate

    l.l_shipmode

SELECT
    c.c_name,
    c.c_custkey,
    o.o_orderkey,
    o.o_orderdate,
    o.o_totalprice,
    SUM(l.l_quantity) AS sum_extendedprice
FROM
    orders o
JOIN
    customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN
    lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
GROUP BY
    c.c_name,
    c.c_custkey,
    o.o_orderkey,
    o.o_orderdate,
    o.o_totalprice
HAVING
    SUM(l.l_quantity) > 300
ORDER BY
    o.o_totalprice DESC,
    o.o_orderdate ASC
LIMIT 100

SELECT 
    n1.n_name AS supp_nation,
    n2.n_name AS cust_nation,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS l_year,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n1 ON s.s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
WHERE 
    n1.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY')
    AND n2.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY')
    AND n1.n_name <> n2.n_name
    AND l.l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate <= '1996-12-31'
GROUP BY n1.n_name, n2.n_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)
ORDER BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year

SELECT
      n.n_name,
      SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
    FROM
      lineitem l
      JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
      JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
      JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
      JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    WHERE
      r.r_name = 'ASIA'
      AND o.o_orderdate >= '1994-01-01'
      AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-01-01'
    GROUP BY
      n.n_name
    ORDER BY
      revenue DESC

SELECT 
  n1.n_name AS supp_nation,
  n2.n_name AS cust_nation,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS l_year,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n1 ON s.s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
WHERE n1.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY')
  AND n2.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY')
  AND n1.n_name <> n2.n_name
  AND l.l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01'
  AND l.l_shipdate <= '1996-12-31'
GROUP BY n1.n_name, n2.n_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)

WITH min_cost AS (

    ps.ps_partkey,
    MIN(ps.ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
  FROM partsupp ps
  JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
  JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
  WHERE p.p_size = 15
    AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS'
    AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
)

  s.s_acctbal,
  s.s_name,
  n.n_name,
  p.p_partkey,
  p.p_mfgr,
  s.s_address,
  s.s_phone,
  s.s_comment

JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN min_cost mc ON ps.ps_partkey = mc.ps_partkey
WHERE ps.ps_partkey = mc.ps_partkey

  AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  AND p.p_size = 15

ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_partkey

  JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey

  JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
  WHERE p.p_size = 15
    AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS'
    AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
),

  SELECT 
    ps_partkey,
    MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
  FROM partsupp
  JOIN supplier ON ps_partkey = ps_suppkey
  JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey
  JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey
  JOIN part ON ps_partkey = p_partkey
  WHERE p_size = 15
    AND p_type LIKE '%BRASS'
    AND r_name = 'EUROPE'
  GROUP BY ps_partkey

JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey

```sql
WITH min_cost AS (
    SELECT
        ps_partkey,
        MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
    FROM partsupp
    GROUP BY ps_partkey
),
supplier_info AS (
    SELECT
        ps_partkey,
        ps_supplycost,
        s.s_acctbal,
        s.s_name,
        s.s_address,
        s.s_phone,
        s.s_comment,
        n.n_name,
        p.p_mfgr,
        p.p_partkey,
        p.p_size,
        p.p_type
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
      AND p.p_size = 15
      AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS'
)
SELECT
    s_acctbal,
    s_name,
    n_name,
    p_partkey,
    p_mfgr,
    s_address,
    s_phone,
    s_comment
FROM supplier_info
WHERE ps_supplycost = (SELECT min_cost FROM min_cost WHERE ps_partkey = p_partkey)
ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC, n_name, s_name, p_partkey
LIMIT 100;
```

WITH supplier_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_suppkey,
        s.s_name,
        s.s_address,
        s.s_phone,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01'
      AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-04-01'
    GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone
)
SELECT
    s_suppkey,
    s_name,
    s_address,
    s_phone,
    total_revenue
FROM supplier_revenue
WHERE total_revenue = (SELECT MIN(total_revenue) FROM supplier_revenue)

    ```sql
    WITH supplier_revenue AS (

    COUNT(*) AS numwait
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA'

    AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate

WITH min_cost AS (

  FROM partsupp ps
  JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
  JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
  WHERE p.p_size = 15 
    AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS'
    AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey

  p.p_type,
  p.p_size,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM
  part p

  partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey

  supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey

  AND s.s_comment NOT LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
  AND s.s_acctbal < 0

  p.p_brand,
  p.p_type,
  p.p_size

  supplier_cnt DESC,
  p.p_brand ASC,
  p.p_type ASC,

  c.c_name,
  c.c_custkey,

FROM orders o

JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
GROUP BY c.c_name, c.c_custkey, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice
HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 300
ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC, o.o_orderdate
LIMIT 100
```

SELECT s.s_name, COUNT(*) AS numwait
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA'
  AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F'
  AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM lineitem l2
    WHERE l2.l_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    AND l2.l_suppkey != l.l_suppkey
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM lineitem l3
    WHERE l3.l_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    AND l3.l_suppkey != l.l_suppkey
    AND l3.l_receiptdate > l3.l_commitdate
  )
GROUP BY s.s_name
ORDER BY numwait DESC, s.s_name
LIMIT 100
